messages:
maria: FYI — opened the follow-up thread for yesterday's multi-vendor outage (cloud networking + model-registry auth). Postmortem up: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PM-789
chris: thanks, linking this to infra sprint. primary ask: short-term fallback for model fetch failures
liz: can we get an explicit owner for model-registry auth rotation? recommend 2w deadline
amar: I'll take the cloud fallback gating + runbook updates. plan: add prefix caching + retry jitter. ETA Fri 2026-04-02
kaela: security to review auth rotation plan, will pair with liz. ETA Tue 2026-03-30
maria: action items:
- Amar: cloud request routing fallback (multi-region failover) — due 2026-04-02
- Liz: model-registry credential rotation and short-lived tokens — due 2026-03-30
- Chris: infra SLA guardrails w/ cloud provider (contract + contact) — due 2026-04-09
- Kaela: threat review & audit logging on auth provider flows — due 2026-03-30
chris: adding vendor tickets: opened with CloudNet (#CN-445) and AuthCo (#AC-881)
incident-bot: Reminder: 48h check-in scheduled for 2026-03-28 10:00am UTC
amar: quick runbook draft for fallback added below:
```
if model registry returns 5xx or 401:
 - try regional replica (X-Region header)
 - use pinned model bundle (last-known-good) for 30s
 - if still failing, switch to smaller fallback model and log ticket
```
liz: small note: pinned model bundle must be verified via checksum before use
maria: recurring pattern: third-party auth provider throttle + cloud network blips. propose quarterly dependency review + monthly chaos-tests for provider outages
chris: agree. propose "dependency SLA and chaos" agenda for next infra retro
amar: status update: started testing retry jitter ±300ms on dev, reduced 5xx by ~60% in synthetic tests
kaela: will validate rotation plan by EOD Monday
maria: let's capture owners in the incident tracker — @chris can you create a single ticket with subitems (CN/AC/infra/internal) and link here?
chris: will create: INC-2026-0302-crossvendor-mitigation and add sub-tasks. link when up
maria: good. everyone mark progress w/ statuses: todo/in-progress/block/done. I'll ping in 72h for blockers :clock3:
liz: FYI I added docs link for token rotation: https://docs.redwood.ai/runbooks/token-rotation
amar: test notes: added commands we used to simulate region failover:
```
kubectl cordon node-aws-5
tc qdisc add dev eth0 root netem loss 30%
```
chris: vendor contact info: CloudNet SRE: cloudnet-sre@cloudnet.example, Escalation SEP: +1-555-0123
maria: thanks — i'll consolidate and post an internal follow-up email after tickets created
maria: tagging this thread as follow-up-tracker and will update statuses here as tasks make progress
